title: Review finder angles
description: Finder angles for review:code, with the preamble and precedence blocks every finder receives.

preamble.description: Candidate shape and the no-suppression rule, given to every finder.

angles.description: Angles in the order finders receive them.

sets.description: Angle sets this angle belongs to. Stated rather than derived, so the xhigh-only angles are explicit.

cleanupPrecedence.description: Emitted when the selected set carries a cleanup, altitude, or conventions angle.

sweepGapFocus.description: Emitted when the cell runs a sweep pass.
